hunks.before: v_unrelated bytea; v_actual jsonb; v_expected jsonb; v_signature jsonb;
hunks.after:
v_unrelated bytea; v_actual jsonb; v_signature jsonb;
  v_after_fin public.timesheets_financials%rowtype; v_line_ids jsonb;

v_plan:=private.weekly_source_agency_invoice_segment_selection_v1(v_request.current_timesheet_id,v_fin.id,v_invoice.id);
    if v_plan->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'INVOICE_EDIT_NATIVE_SEGMENT_SELECTION_WITNESS_V1'
      or v_plan->>'timesheet_id' is distinct from v_request.current_timesheet_id::text
      or v_plan->>'financial_id' is distinct from v_fin.id::text or v_plan->>'invoice_id' is distinct from v_invoice.id::text
      or v_plan->'segments' is distinct from v_fin.invoice_breakdown_json->'segments' then
      raise exception 'AGENCY_DRAFT_ROUND_TRIP_NATIVE_COMPONENT_SUBSET_REFUSED' using errcode='55000';end if;
    -- Literal unchanged native editor/service branch, with one internally derived
    -- payload. No expected money/VAT/line calculator or general permission change.
    v_result:=public.invoice_apply_edits(v_invoice.id,jsonb_build_object('add_timesheet_ids',jsonb_build_array(v_request.current_timesheet_id)),p_actor_user_id);
    select * into strict v_after_fin from public.timesheets_financials where id=v_fin.id and is_current;
    if to_jsonb(v_after_fin)-array['invoice_breakdown_json','locked_by_invoice_id','locked_at_utc','updated_at']
       is distinct from to_jsonb(v_fin)-array['invoice_breakdown_json','locked_by_invoice_id','locked_at_utc','updated_at']
      or v_after_fin.invoice_breakdown_json-'segments' is distinct from v_fin.invoice_breakdown_json-'segments'
      or (select jsonb_agg(s.value-'invoice_locked_invoice_id' order by s.ordinality)
          from jsonb_array_elements(v_after_fin.invoice_breakdown_json->'segments') with ordinality s(value,ordinality))
       is distinct from (select jsonb_agg(s.value-'invoice_locked_invoice_id' order by s.ordinality)
          from jsonb_array_elements(v_fin.invoice_breakdown_json->'segments') with ordinality s(value,ordinality))
      or (jsonb_array_length(v_plan->'segments')>0 and
          (v_after_fin.locked_by_invoice_id is distinct from v_invoice.id or v_after_fin.locked_at_utc is null))
      or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_after_fin.invoice_breakdown_json->'segments') s
        where s->>'invoice_locked_invoice_id' is distinct from v_invoice.id::text) then
      raise exception 'AGENCY_DRAFT_ROUND_TRIP_COMPLETE_NATIVE_COMPONENTS_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000';end if;
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l) order by l.id),'[]'::jsonb),coalesce(jsonb_agg(l.id order by l.id),'[]'::jsonb)
      into v_actual,v_line_ids from public.invoice_lines l where l.invoice_id=v_invoice.id and l.timesheet_id=v_request.current_timesheet_id;
    if (jsonb_array_length(v_plan->'segments')>0 and jsonb_array_length(v_actual)=0)
      or (jsonb_array_length(v_plan->'segments')=0 and jsonb_array_length(v_actual)<>0)
      or (select count(distinct l->>'source_key') from jsonb_array_elements(v_actual) l)<>jsonb_array_length(v_actual)
      or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_actual) l
        where l#>>'{meta_json,tsfin_id}' is distinct from v_fin.id::text
          or l->>'booking_id' is distinct from (select booking_id from public.timesheets where timesheet_id=v_request.current_timesheet_id)
          or l->>'invoice_id' is distinct from v_invoice.id::text or l->>'timesheet_id' is distinct from v_request.current_timesheet_id::text) then
      raise exception 'AGENCY_DRAFT_ROUND_TRIP_NATIVE_LINE_IDENTITY_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000';end if;
    -- Complete actual identity census from this native call; hashes do not assert
    -- independent rendered document order or another monetary qualification.
    v_plan:=v_plan||jsonb_build_object('native_invoice_line_ids',v_line_ids,
      'native_invoice_lines_sha256',encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('AGENCY_DRAFT_NATIVE_RETURNED_LINES_V1',v_actual),'hex'),
      'native_locked_segments_sha256',encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('AGENCY_DRAFT_NATIVE_RETURNED_SEGMENTS_V1',v_after_fin.invoice_breakdown_json->'segments'),'hex'));

hunks.before: if (v_result is not null and jsonb_typeof(v_result) is distinct from 'object')
hunks.after:
if (v_result is not null and (jsonb_typeof(v_result) is distinct from 'object'
      or v_result->>'invoice_id' is distinct from v_invoice.id::text
      or v_result->>'status' not in('DRAFT','ON_HOLD')))
